about.registryInfo: Monthly subscription series of the Peakwater Volatility Alpha Fund, registered sub-fund T24VC0084D-SF004 of Pilgrim Investment VCC (Singapore VCC Act); manager Pilgrim Partners Asia (MAS CMS licence); tokenized and distributed by DigiFT (MAS-licensed exchange). Listed as its own row rather than as an extra contract on pEAK (#4094) because each series carries its own NAV - one combined row blends units across NAVs and books phantom flows at every roll-up. DigiFT SubRedManagement contract balance (pending subscriptions/redemptions) excluded.
